newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 266-day T-bill yields avg 22.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 266-day T-bill yields avg 22.00 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 266-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 22.00 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
Dealers had forecast the average yield would be 22.34 percent to 23.14 percent.
Series 23002 bills, maturing on February 18, 1998, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed on Tuesday at 86.25 to yield 22.38 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:
Later on Wednesday the Finance Ministry will auction 4.50 trillion roubles of an additional 113-day tranche of series 22082 bills.
It will also repay about 8.92 trillion roubles in a maturing issue of 238-day T-bills (series 23053).
